query:
SELECT DISTINCT s.principal_id FROM big_sync_syncable s
                  WHERE s.scope_id = ?1
                    AND s.part_ref IN (
                        SELECT m.maybe_part_ref FROM big_sync_members m
                         WHERE m.scope_id = ?1 AND m.obj_ref = ?2
                           AND m.maybe_part_ref > 0 AND m.event_type != 2
                    )
